title: Long-lived computer Phase 4: background processes and the preview relay
description: Process supervision, ports and logs, outbound request relay, preview on a separate registrable domain (D12 needs the domain), refresh-on-change instead of WebSocket HMR, task size 0.5 vCPU and 1 GiB. Depends on 2a.
right_now_summary: The work covers process supervision, request relaying, ports, logs, and a separate preview domain.
